using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Storage;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Persistence.AzureStorage.Tests
{
    public class AzureTableGrainStorageFactoryTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void Create_ShouldCallGetRequiredServiceAndCreateInstance()
        {
            // Arrange
            var servicesMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            var serviceCollection = new ServiceCollection();

            var optionsMonitorMock = new Mock<IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>>();
            var options = new AzureTableStorageOptions();
            optionsMonitorMock.Setup(m => m.Get(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(options);

            serviceCollection.AddSingleton(optionsMonitorMock.Object);
            var serviceProvider = serviceCollection.BuildServiceProvider();

            // Setup IServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>> to return our mock
            servicesMock.Setup(s => s.GetService(typeof(IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>)))
                .Returns(optionsMonitorMock.Object);

            // Setup extension method GetRequiredService to call GetService and throw if null
            // We simulate this by using the real serviceProvider for GetRequiredService
            // But since the factory method calls GetRequiredService on the passed IServiceProvider,
            // we pass the real serviceProvider here.

            // We also need to mock GetProviderClusterOptions extension method on IServiceProvider
            // It is not shown in the snippet, so we will mock it as an extension method by creating a helper class

            var clusterOptions = new ClusterOptions();
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            services.AddSingleton(Options.Create(clusterOptions));
            var sp = services.BuildServiceProvider();

            // We will create a minimal IServiceProvider that returns the optionsMonitorMock and clusterOptions
            var spMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            spMock.Setup(s => s.GetService(typeof(IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>))).Returns(optionsMonitorMock.Object);
            spMock.Setup(s => s.GetService(typeof(IOptions<ClusterOptions>))).Returns(Options.Create(clusterOptions));

            // We need to mock the extension method GetProviderClusterOptions
            // Since extension methods cannot be mocked directly, we create a helper class with the same method signature
            // and use it in the test instead of the extension method.

            // Act
            var storage = AzureTableGrainStorageFactory.Create(spMock.Object, "TestName");

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(storage);
            optionsMonitorMock.Verify(m => m.Get("TestName"), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Storage;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Persistence.AzureStorage.Tests
{
    public class AzureTableGrainStorageFactoryTests
    {
        private class DummyClusterOptions
        {
        }

        private class DummyAzureTableStorageOptions : AzureTableStorageOptions
        {
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Create_ShouldCallGetRequiredServiceAndCreateInstance()
        {
            // Arrange
            var servicesMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();

            var optionsMonitorMock = new Mock<IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>>();
            var options = new AzureTableStorageOptions();
            optionsMonitorMock.Setup(m => m.Get(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(options);

            var clusterOptions = new DummyClusterOptions();

            servicesMock.Setup(s => s.GetService(typeof(IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>)))
                .Returns(optionsMonitorMock.Object);

            // We need to mock the extension method GetProviderClusterOptions
            // Since extension methods cannot be mocked directly, we simulate it by adding a method to IServiceProvider
            // But here we just setup GetService for IOptions<DummyClusterOptions> to return clusterOptions wrapped in Options

            servicesMock.Setup(s => s.GetService(typeof(IOptions<DummyClusterOptions>)))
                .Returns(Options.Create(clusterOptions));

            // Act
            // The factory method calls GetRequiredService<IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>> and GetProviderClusterOptions(name)
            // We simulate GetProviderClusterOptions by extension method that calls GetService<IOptions<ClusterOptions>>
            // Since ClusterOptions type is not found, we use DummyClusterOptions as a stand-in

            var storage = AzureTableGrainStorageFactory.Create(servicesMock.Object, "TestName");

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(storage);
            optionsMonitorMock.Verify(m => m.Get("TestName"), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Orleans.Configuration.Overrides;
using Orleans.Storage;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Persistence.AzureStorage.Tests
{
    public class AzureTableGrainStorageFactoryTests
    {
        private class TestServiceProvider : IServiceProvider
        {
            private readonly IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions> optionsMonitor;
            private readonly IOptions<ClusterOptions> clusterOptions;

            public TestServiceProvider(IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions> optionsMonitor, IOptions<ClusterOptions> clusterOptions)
            {
                this.optionsMonitor = optionsMonitor;
                this.clusterOptions = clusterOptions;
            }

            public object? GetService(Type serviceType)
            {
                if (serviceType == typeof(IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>))
                    return optionsMonitor;
                if (serviceType == typeof(IOptions<ClusterOptions>))
                    return clusterOptions;
                return null;
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Create_ShouldCallGetRequiredServiceAndCreateInstance()
        {
            // Arrange
            var options = new AzureTableStorageOptions();
            var optionsMonitorMock = new Mock<IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>>();
            optionsMonitorMock.Setup(m => m.Get(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(options);

            var clusterOptions = new ClusterOptions();

            var serviceProvider = new TestServiceProvider(optionsMonitorMock.Object, Options.Create(clusterOptions));

            // Act
            var storage = AzureTableGrainStorageFactory.Create(serviceProvider, "TestName");

            // Assert
            Assert.NotNull(storage);
            optionsMonitorMock.Verify(m => m.Get("TestName"), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
